WITH d AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO alerts (
    schema_version, alert_id, source, source_event_id, category, subtype,
    status, event_action, title, message, priority, county, municipality,
    location, tags, click_url, source_url, observed_at, source_updated_at,
    received_at, expires_at, metadata, raw_payload, updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    COALESCE(j->>'schema_version', '1.0'),
    j->>'alert_id', j->>'source', NULLIF(j->>'source_event_id', ''),
    j->>'category', j->>'subtype', j->>'status', j->>'event_action',
    j->>'title', j->>'message', (j->>'priority')::integer,
    NULLIF(j->>'county', ''), NULLIF(j->>'municipality', ''),
    COALESCE(j->'location', '{}'::jsonb),
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(j->'tags', '[]'::jsonb))),
    NULLIF(j->>'click_url', ''), NULLIF(j->>'source_url', ''),
    NULLIF(j->>'observed_at', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(j->>'source_updated_at', '')::timestamptz,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'received_at', '')::timestamptz, NOW()),
    NULLIF(j->>'expires_at', '')::timestamptz,
    COALESCE(j->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb), j, NOW()
  FROM d
  ON CONFLICT (alert_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    source_event_id = EXCLUDED.source_event_id,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    event_action = EXCLUDED.event_action,
    title = EXCLUDED.title,
    message = EXCLUDED.message,
    priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
    county = EXCLUDED.county,
    municipality = EXCLUDED.municipality,
    location = EXCLUDED.location,
    tags = EXCLUDED.tags,
    click_url = EXCLUDED.click_url,
    source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
    observed_at = EXCLUDED.observed_at,
    source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at,
    received_at = EXCLUDED.received_at,
    expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
    raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload,
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id::text AS alert_db_uuid, alert_id
)
SELECT d.j AS alert, upserted.alert_db_uuid, upserted.alert_id
FROM d CROSS JOIN upserted;

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
),
a AS (
  SELECT alerts.id FROM alerts, d WHERE alerts.alert_id = d.j->>'alert_id'
),
s AS (
  SELECT subscribers.id FROM subscribers, d WHERE subscribers.subscriber_id = d.j->>'subscriber_id'
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO deliveries (
    delivery_key, alert_id, subscriber_id, ntfy_topic, status,
    attempted_at, sent_at, error_message, matched_watch_ids
  )
  SELECT
    (d.j->>'alert_id') || '|' || (d.j->>'subscriber_id') || '|' ||
      COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'ntfy_message_id', ''), md5(d.j::text)),
    a.id, s.id, d.j->>'ntfy_topic',
    CASE WHEN COALESCE((d.j->>'sent')::boolean, false) THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
    NOW(),
    CASE WHEN COALESCE((d.j->>'sent')::boolean, false) THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE((d.j->>'sent')::boolean, false) THEN NULL ELSE 'ntfy sender returned sent=false' END,
    COALESCE(d.j->'matched_watch_ids', '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM d CROSS JOIN a CROSS JOIN s
  ON CONFLICT (delivery_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id::text AS delivery_uuid, delivery_key, status, sent_at
)
SELECT * FROM inserted;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO subscribers (subscriber_id, name, active, ntfy_topic, notes)
VALUES ('PSEG_CHANNEL', 'PSEG Channel', true, 'PSEG', 'Initial City Manager OS PSEG delivery destination')
ON CONFLICT (subscriber_id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name, active = true, ntfy_topic = EXCLUDED.ntfy_topic,
  notes = EXCLUDED.notes, updated_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO watch_items (
  watch_id, active, watch_type, display_name, search_term, aliases,
  match_mode, match_field, category, subcategory, source_filter,
  alert_category_filter, min_priority, notes
)
VALUES (
  'W_PSEG_SOURCE', true, 'SOURCE', 'PSEG', 'PSEG', ARRAY['PSE&G'],
  'FIELD', 'source', 'UTILITY', 'POWER', ARRAY['PSEG'], ARRAY['UTILITY'], 1,
  'Routes normalized PSEG utility alerts through the central router'
)
ON CONFLICT (watch_id) DO UPDATE SET
  active = true, watch_type = EXCLUDED.watch_type,
  display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, search_term = EXCLUDED.search_term,
  aliases = EXCLUDED.aliases, match_mode = EXCLUDED.match_mode,
  match_field = EXCLUDED.match_field, category = EXCLUDED.category,
  subcategory = EXCLUDED.subcategory, source_filter = EXCLUDED.source_filter,
  alert_category_filter = EXCLUDED.alert_category_filter,
  min_priority = EXCLUDED.min_priority, notes = EXCLUDED.notes, updated_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO watch_items (
  watch_id, active, watch_type, display_name, search_term, aliases,
  match_mode, match_field, category, subcategory, source_filter,
  alert_category_filter, min_priority, municipality, county, state, notes
)
VALUES (
  'W_WEEHAWKEN_TOWN', true, 'TOWN', 'Weehawken', 'WEEHAWKEN', '{}',
  'FIELD', 'municipality', 'GEOGRAPHY', 'MUNICIPALITY', '{}', '{}', 1,
  'WEEHAWKEN', 'HUDSON', 'NJ', 'Initial municipal watch item for City Manager OS'
)
ON CONFLICT (watch_id) DO UPDATE SET
  active = true, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,
  search_term = EXCLUDED.search_term, match_mode = EXCLUDED.match_mode,
  match_field = EXCLUDED.match_field, municipality = EXCLUDED.municipality,
  county = EXCLUDED.county, state = EXCLUDED.state,
  notes = EXCLUDED.notes, updated_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO watch_item_recipients (watch_item_id, subscriber_id, active)
SELECT wi.id, s.id, true
FROM watch_items wi
JOIN subscribers s ON s.subscriber_id = 'PSEG_CHANNEL'
WHERE wi.watch_id IN ('W_PSEG_SOURCE', 'W_WEEHAWKEN_TOWN')
ON CONFLICT (watch_item_id, subscriber_id) DO UPDATE SET active = true;

SELECT wi.watch_id, wi.display_name, s.subscriber_id, s.ntfy_topic, wir.active
FROM watch_item_recipients wir
JOIN watch_items wi ON wi.id = wir.watch_item_id
JOIN subscribers s ON s.id = wir.subscriber_id
WHERE wi.watch_id IN ('W_PSEG_SOURCE', 'W_WEEHAWKEN_TOWN')
ORDER BY wi.watch_id;
